senses.gloss: औ॑दुम्बर mf(ई)n. (in class. Sanskṛt commonly written औडु˚) (fr. उद् [ड्] उम्ब॑र), coming from the tree Udumbara or Ficus Religiosa, made of its wood, AV.; ŚBr.; Mn. ii, 45; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
made of copper, SāmavBr. ii, 5, 3
औ॑दुम्बर m. a region abounding in Udumbara trees, Kāś. on Pāṇ. iv, 2, 67
a kind of worm, Car.
N. of Yama
औ॑दुम्बर m. pl. N. of a race, MBh.
औ॑दुम्बर m. of a class of ascetics, Hariv. 7988; BhP. iii, 12, 43
औ॑दुम्बर n. an Udumbara wood, KātyŚr.
a piece of Udumbara wood, PārGṛ.
the fruit of the Udumbara tree, AitBr.
a kind of leprosy, Suśr.
copper, L.
औ॑दुम्बरी f. (with and without शाखा) a branch of the Udumbara tree, ŚBr. : Lāṭy.; Nyāyam. &c.
a kind of musical instrument
औदुम्बरी f. (with संहिता) N. of a wk. on Bhakti (accord. to Nimbārka).
औदुम्बरि m. a king of the Udumbaras Comm. on Pāṇ.
औदुम्बर—च्छद m. Croton Polyandrum, Nigh.
औदुम्बर—ता f.
औदुम्बर—त्व n. the state of being made of the Udumbara tree, Nyāyam.
औदुम्बरक m. the country inhabited by the Udumbaras g. राजन्यादि, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 53.
औदुम्बरायण m. a descendant of Udumbara, N. of a grammarian.
a married Brāhman, L.
औदुम्बरायणि m. a descendant of the last.
